description: This PHP source file defines the class ConfiguratorViewHistoryContactsEmails, which manages the display and configuration of history contacts emails within the SuiteCRM application. It includes logic for user authorization, module processing, subpanel setup validation, and template rendering.

classes.name: ConfiguratorViewHistoryContactsEmails
classes.description: A view class extending SugarView, responsible for displaying a configuration page related to history contacts emails in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks if the current user has admin privileges and terminates execution if not.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and renders a list of modules with history contacts email features enabled, based on subpanel configurations, user permissions, and global settings.
